What is good enough for promotion?

There is no universal accuracy or log-loss pass mark. Register the target, primary metric, matched support, season/week clustering, confidence and multiplicity policy, calibration guardrails, stability, coverage, resource cost and rollback before observing a new cohort. Compare the same events, target, horizon and source eligibility. Keep win probability, expected home margin, expected total/final score and calibrated cover probability as separate targets, with score/margin/total coherence and explicit push/overtime rules.

Historical qualification is a research gate

The recovered role code requires at least 500 pooled games, 100 in each frozen season and eight season/week clusters. Those requirements and the saved multiplicity method are not universal promotion thresholds. Development-exposed best scores require independent confirmation and calibration/stability review.

Prospective evidence starts after registration

Monitoring current outcomes cannot rewrite old forecasts or turn a post-observation policy into an independent prospective test. New prospective credit begins only after registration and actual durable issuance. A new score, model fit or website deployment alone does not promote a model.

Evidence and continuation

This report adds authenticated terminal evidence without fitting models, acquiring market data, issuing predictions or changing champions operationally. All older published data remains in the dated view below. Full rolling-champion terminal completion and B063 owner parallel execution remain unverified.
